name: Home (agents-flow) perf

actions.comment: Was a bare `goto` with no session. Every route here is behind the kernel token and the setup wizard now, so each probe measured the /login redirect rather than the view it names. goto-view seeds the session and waits for the shell first.

actions.value: (()=>{const n=performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0]||{},p=performance.getEntriesByType('paint'),f=p.find(x=>x.name==='first-contentful-paint'),r=performance.getEntriesByType('resource'),tb=r.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.transferSize||0),0),h=(performance.memory&&performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize)||0,m={path:location.pathname,ttfb:Math.round(n.responseStart||0),dcl:Math.round(n.domContentLoadedEventEnd||0),load:Math.round(n.loadEventEnd||0),fcp:Math.round((f&&f.startTime)||0),resources:r.length,kb:Math.round(tb/1024),heapMb:Math.round(h/104857.6)/10};const b=document.createElement('div');b.id='perf-banner';b.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:99999;padding:8px 12px;background:#000;color:#0f0;font:11px/1.4 monospace;border-bottom:2px solid #0f0';b.textContent='PERF '+m.path+' ttfb='+m.ttfb+'ms dcl='+m.dcl+'ms load='+m.load+'ms fcp='+m.fcp+'ms resources='+m.resources+' kb='+m.kb+' heapMb='+m.heapMb;document.body.appendChild(b);})()

expect: Green PERF banner at top with path, ttfb, dcl, load, fcp, resources, kb, heapMb
